mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER_SIGNUP_VERIFICATIONS (channel, target, code, expires_at, verified_at, last_requested_at) VALUES (#{channel}, #{target}, #{code}, #{expiresAt}, NULL, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE code = #{code}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, verified_at = NULL, last_requested_at = #{now}, attempt_count = 0, consumed_at = NULL
